answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil swarms by requiring each participant to stake verifiable hardware attestation bonds before joining the cluster. Like a shared orchard where each tree must take deep root, every node anchors its identity in a secure enclave. Entities that harbor unverified replicas are isolated and their stakes slashed by peer consensus, like weeding wild yarrow from a bed. An attacker fabricating thousands of clones faces linear hardware procurement expenses and superlinear collateral forfeiture per forged identity.
